proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Prove the three group-suffixed helper declarations structurally from xizi_dllseg and points-to separation. For initialization, open xizi_dll and choose done=nil/todo=nodes. For each advancing witness, unfold the nonterminal remainder, extend the prefix by the current node, instantiate the new logical lists, and prove no unsigned wrap from the remaining-node fact and the total size bound. For the two return witnesses, destruct the terminal segment list; its nonempty case is contradictory because start=stop, while the nil case closes either a nonempty prefix or the empty DLL.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: One worker handles the complete circular-DLL traversal family in manual witness order, reusing the same suffixed spatial helpers and length-normalization pattern across all five proofs. Avoid every forbidden lemma; use definition unfolding, structural induction, cancellation, xizi_dll public lemmas, list rewrites, unsigned_last_nbits_eq and arithmetic only.
proof_groups.proof_pattern_summary: sentinel DLL open -> segment unfold/advance -> unsigned counter preservation -> segment close
proving_hints: The generated definitions are Coq disjunctions of alternative entailment shapes; selecting and proving the first disjunct suffices for each current theorem.
In entail_wit_2_1, unfold the next_2-starting suffix before deriving tmp_node <> next_2 from separated link ownership.
For unsigned_last_nbits_eq, derive the strict upper bound from xizi_double_link_size nodes = Zlength nodes <= 4294967295 and the fact that the remaining suffix contains the current next node.
At return, destruct todo before folding/closing: xizi_dllseg linklist_pre _ linklist_pre _ todo makes the cons case contradictory and the nil case exposes the needed last-pointer equality.
Keep all reusable top-level helpers in the group-local case_lib with suffix __dll_traversal_and_closure; the manual file must contain witness proofs only.
